messages.subject: [STATSGRASS] Help: printer with GRASS
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I am trying to print some thematic maps that I made for a GIS research on 
Linux-GRASS, but the printer doesn't work for the map paintings.
The problems concerns both the printers that I have (EPSON STYLUS PRO and 
EPSON UX40).
I tried also to do it with the p.map command within GRASS, but it seems to 
be problems with color setting.
Could anyone help me about it? I would be grateful about any suggestion.

Thank you in advance


Giuliano Pelfer

messages.subject: [STATSGRASS] gstat_compilation_error
messages.body_plain:
A while ago, some versions of grass had all the symbols stripped from
libgis.a and libgrass.a. Update your grass version (or the version
of the libraries in /usr/local/grass5/lib at least) and things
should compile fine.

Best regards,
--
Edzer
